title: Midterm polls that caught our eye this week show more good news for Democrats
description: Polls show close contests in competitive Senate races and rare independent polling in Virginia congressional races.

title: Democrats expand battleground for House, reaching into bloodred districts
description: The additions include Kansas’s 2nd, Michigan’s 1st, North Carolina’s 13th, New Jersey’s 2nd, Oklahoma’s 5th, Texas’s 9th, Virginia’s 6th and Washington’s 5th.

title: Dems are running against the One Big Beautiful Bill. What can they do if they win?
description: Could a Democratic-led House actually do anything about the One Big Beautiful Bill Act? Maybe not.

title: Sanders, Ocasio-Cortez debut bill to crack down on Flock cameras
description: The legislation is part of a bipartisan backlash against a technology that has been abused by law enforcement.

title: San Francisco's car crime has plunged. How much credit does Flock deserve?
description: San Francisco leaders say AI-powered cameras helped drive a dramatic decline in car crime. We examine the evidence — and whether the city can keep its high-tech dragnet without sacrificing civil liberties.

title: Failed 'torturous' execution attempt on Christa Pike reignites death penalty debate
description: The botched execution in Tennessee of Christa Pike, who survived despite being subject to two doses of lethal injection on Wednesday, has reignited furious debate about the death penalty in the U.S.

title: The U.S. Senate is up for grabs. Can this Ohio Democrat win back working class votes?
description: After 32 years in Congress, Ohio's Sherrod Brown lost his Senate seat in 2024 as many working class voters turned out for Trump. Now Brown is counting on union voters to send him back to Washington.

title: Trump embarks on rally blitz, hoping to energize GOP voters
description: Trump’s low standing with voters limits the places he can most effectively campaign. Advisers hope he can energize GOP voters.

title: ‘I am haunted’: Tennessee grapples with questions after another botched execution
description: State officials tried and failed to execute Christa Pike. She is now in critical condition, her lawyers said Thursday, and they have not been able to see or speak with her since she was hospitalized.

title: Trump illegally fired Seattle’s U.S. attorney, judge rules
description: The ruling is the latest in a string of decisions finding that the administration bent federal law to keep loyalists in key prosecutorial posts.

title: Larry Nassar among thousands of sex offenders removed from Michigan registry
description: The state struck 20,000 names from the public database after a ruling by the state’s highest court.

title: DOJ charges Boston man with threatening conservative podcaster Katie Miller
description: Federal authorities on Thursday charged a Boston-area man with harassing Katie Miller, a conservative podcaster and wife of Trump aide Stephen Miller.

title: Trump defies Democrats, diverts aid for Europe to Latin America instead
description: The diverted funds include tens of millions of dollars that Congress approved for countries affected by the war in Ukraine.

title: What is ketamine, the drug at the center of the alleged rape at Cornell?
description: The controlled substance is approved as an anesthetic, but also has long been abused as a party and date rape drug.

title: Democrats sue over Pentagon’s changes to voter forms for Americans overseas
description: Advocates for U.S. citizens overseas say the changes may spark confusion among eligible voters abroad and local election offices.

title: Trump memecoin plans another gala amid backlash to self-enrichment
description: The latest event will take place next month at the president’s golf club in Northern Virginia.

title: Trump wins approval for new White House visitor screening center
description: The project, which would revamp how visitors enter the White House grounds, is one Trump construction effort that has drawn wide agreement.

title: Campaign-style Trump ads use money meant for border security, memorials
description: The White House Office of Management and Budget added $20 million to the pot for commemorative events a day before DHS awarded an advertising contract of the same amount.

title: Congress just left town until after the midterm elections
description: Republicans have to campaign without having done much to address the cost of living.

title: Trump sends out $500 ACA refunds and a letter promoting his record
description: The rebate checks are headed to nearly 1 million people President Donald Trump says were overcharged under the Affordable Care Act.

title: GOP hold on Florida and Texas governors’ races weakens, nonpartisan analyst says
description: President Donald Trump’s poor ratings contributed to the Cook Political Report shifting both races from “Likely Republican” to “Lean Republican.”

title: Trump says Secret Service wants him to ‘take down’ Oval Office
description: The president also said he is looking into designating the White House room as a “federal landmark,” potentially preserving his changes.

title: Supreme Court to scrutinize ICE’s mandatory detention policy for immigrants
description: The case, one of the first the court has accepted since its summer recess ended, promises to be among the most consequential of the term that begins next week.

title: States sue to stop Trump’s retreat on power plant emissions
description: The Trump administration’s abandonment of climate rules at the nation’s most polluting power plants is being challenged in federal court by 21 states, the District of Columbia and three major cities in a federal lawsuit that accuses the Environmental Protection Agency of brazenly shirking a legal obligation.

title: Nebraska’s Dan Osborn responds to audio commenting on Trump supporters
description: Osborn, an independent running for Senate, answered rapid-fire questions.

title: 4 takeaways from Trump’s Time magazine interview
description: Just over a month before the midterm elections, President Donald Trump addressed the top issues confronting his administration in a wide-ranging interview with Time magazine.

title: Trump loses favor with crypto fans who call him out for cashing in
description: The president’s 2024 campaign leaned into crypto to attract young men, a demographic that is deserting Republicans in the midterms.

title: Trump does not rule out demolishing the Kennedy Center
description: The Kennedy Center was closed last month amid a legal battle over whether President Donald Trump can add his name to the performing arts venue.

title: The Pollwatcher: How much can Republicans outrun Trump’s approval ratings?
description: Plus: Can AI replace human poll respondents?

title: A judge permanently dismisses former Olympian's Reflecting Pool charges
description: Citing "exceptional circumstances," a D.C. judge has ruled that the federal government cannot refile its Reflecting Pool charges against David Hearn, despite pressure from President Trump to do so.

title: Tennessee halts scheduled executions after inmate survives lethal injection
description: Christa Pike, who was convicted in a brutal 1995 killing, continued breathing after she was given two doses of lethal injection drugs, her lawyers said.

title: Elon Musk to return his attention to government, advise Pentagon on future of war
description: Musk will join Anduril founder Palmer Luckey and former House Speaker Newt Gingrich on a panel for what the Defense Department is calling Project Meridian.

title: AI data centers: How much are ratepayers on the hook for?
description: Data centers consume large amounts of power and require upgrading infrastructure. But it's difficult to determine how much residential customers benefit and how much they actually pay for the benefit.

title: Democrat has edge in Virginia House race considered national bellwether, poll finds
description: Democrat Shannon Taylor is narrowly ahead of Rep. Rob Wittman (R) in Virginia’s 1st Congressional District, while Democrat Tom Perriello is modestly behind Rep. John McGuire (R) in the 5th.

title: Trump’s playing his greatest hits. They don’t work as well as they used to.
description: With midterm elections a month away, the president is turning the audacity up to 11 as he labors to reverse his party’s decline in the polls.

title: Mississippi Democrats dare to wonder whether Senate seat is in reach
description: A Democrat hasn’t won a Senate race in the state since 1982, but a young district attorney has a message for party officials and donors: “If we try, we win these voters.”

title: Democrats sound the money alarm in a key battleground
description:
Democrats have money problems all over the country.
But the challenge may be most acute — and unexpected — in Wisconsin.

title: California gubernatorial candidates face off in debate
description: California's candidates for governor square off in a debate while the blue-leaning state grapples with affordability and other issues.

title: En esta ciudad de Pensilvania, los dos partidos políticos buscan el voto latino
description: Los republicanos lograron avances con los latinos en el último ciclo electoral, pero la economía y la frustración por la política migratoria de Donald Trump han corroído ese apoyo.

title: COMIC: How the census gives your state power (and what Trump wants to change)
description: The census is used to determine how much say your state has in Congress and the Electoral College. President Trump failed to alter it during his first term, but he's trying again ahead of 2030.

title: Trade tensions mean fewer Canadians flocking to South Florida
description: This South Florida community is typically a refuge for Canadians fleeing cold weather, but trade tensions between the United States and Canada mean fewer are coming.

title: Along U.S. Route 1, Maine voters worry about heating oil, gas and Canadian tariffs
description: Home to both Republican Sen. Susan Collins and Democratic candidate Troy Jackson, Maine's senate race has put rural Aroostook County in the spotlight.

title: Senate leaves town until after the midterms as final bills founder
description: Democrats block several pieces of legislation pushed by Republicans looking for victories ahead of Election Day.

title: Hegseth details new initiatives in partisan address to troops
description: In a fiery speech, the Pentagon chief solicited bids to build a new base, called for more focus on religion and said Elon Musk will help develop next-generation weapons.

title: White House touts big-ticket projects in hope of swaying key races
description: With few tools to bring down prices in the short run, Trump hopes to focus voters on investments that could pay off in years to come.

title: Trump says ‘only Hispanic’ could survive fall at ballroom site
description: Trump invited attendees of a Hispanic Heritage Month to be among the first to walk on his ballroom floor.

title: Building big things in the U.S. is hard. A Senate deal aims to fix that.
description: A sweeping bipartisan plan takes aim at the bottlenecks scuttling new infrastructure.

title: DOJ files complaint against Minn. judges for criticizing immigration surge
description: Several judges spoke to the New York Times about their concerns around the immigration crackdown. One judge Wednesday defended his decision to speak publicly as “well within the ethical rules.”

title: Trump acknowledges bind he faces on immigration policies
description: The president spoke at a Hispanic Heritage Month event as Latino voters abandon him.

title: Ad spending in midterm races crosses $1.5 billion
description: The figure marks an increase of $317 million from last week, according to a Post analysis of data from AdImpact.

description: How to read all these midterm polls.

title: Troy Jackson apologizes for comments on Jewish Mainers’ views of Gaza war
description: The Senate nominee’s bid to unseat incumbent Susan Collins (R) is critical to Democrats’ hopes for reclaiming control of the chamber.

title: Trump’s nominee to be nation’s top doctor clears key hurdle in Senate committee
